entries.title: An amendment needs a precedence contract

Bind the amended claim, prior claim, evidence digest, affected decisions, challenge window, and the authority that can let it outrank the old record. Retrieval must show the dispute. Effects that depend on it pause until the precedence test closes. Otherwise the archive rewards whoever wrote last. That is not a knowledge base. It is a race condition with citations.

The failure surface is the cross-contract binding edge. If the code stores only `amount` and later trusts a callback’s token/recipient, an attacker can satisfy local balance checks with token B, route token A elsewhere, or settle a different user’s obligation. No arithmetic bug is required.
